Microsoft.title: GitHub - yashab-cyber/opendroid: Your Open Autonomous Android Agent — A production-ready, self-planning AI assistant powered by local/remote LLMs and accessibility-driven screen automation.
Microsoft.titleEn: GitHub - yashab-cyber/opendroid: Your Open Autonomous Android Agent — A production-ready, self-planning AI assistant powered by local/remote LLMs and accessibility-driven screen automation.
Microsoft.titleKo: GitHub - yashab-cyber/opendroid: 개방형 자율 Android 에이전트 — 로컬/원격 LLM 및 접근성 기반 화면 자동화를 기반으로 하는 프로덕션 준비, 자체 계획 AI 도우미임
Microsoft.summary:
The project compiles against Java 21 ( jvmToolchain(21) ). gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties makes ./gradlew select an installed JDK 21 automatically, so you do not have to change JAVA_HOME — but a JDK 21 must be installed.
Clean architecture with Dagger-Hilt dependency injection: OpenDroid supports 12 LLM providers with automatic failover: Smart Fallback : If your primary provider fails, OpenDroid automatically tries the next available provider in the chain.
It's a fully autonomous AI agent that lives on your Android phone and actually does things for you.

NVIDIA.title: Securing the Infrastructure of Intelligence
NVIDIA.summary:
Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.
They build and operate AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking, systems and software.
They may have strong customer demand and rapidly growing revenue yet still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.
summaryLinesEn: Each generation of NVIDIA AI factory systems deployed at PORTS-Pike could represent approximately 1.5 million NVIDIA GPUs, or approximately $150 billion to $200 billion in NVIDIA revenue.
They build and operate AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking, systems and software.

They may have strong customer demand and rapidly growing revenue yet still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently.
summaryLinesKo: PORTS-Pike에 배포된 각 세대의 NVIDIA AI 공장 시스템은 약 150만 개의 NVIDIA GPU, 즉 NVIDIA 수익에서 약 1,500억~2,000억 달러를 나타낼 수 있음
그들은 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹, 시스템 및 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 공장을 구축하고 운영함
그들은 강력한 고객 수요와 빠르게 성장하는 수익을 보유하고 있지만 AI 공장 인프라를 독립적으로 확보하는 데 필요한 수십 년 간의 인프라 계약과 투자 등급 자금 조달 능력이 여전히 부족할 수 있음

NVIDIA.titleEn: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
NVIDIA.titleKo: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat, NVIDIA가 현지 AI 인재 개발을 위해 인도네시아 최초의 대학 AI 센터 개설
NVIDIA.summary:
“Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.”
This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center.
“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia의 새로운 5000억 달러 계획은 위험하지만 훌륭함 · 특히 노후화된 GPU의 경우 더욱 그렇음
NVIDIA.summary:
Nvidia announced this week that Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR were willing to commit up to $500 billion to build AI data centers.
The risk is that today’s AI boom, where demand far outstrips capacity, doesn’t continue for much longer.
Specifically, Nvidia is promising that if GPUs used as collateral don’t retain their value as expected, the company will cover up to 25% of the difference.

위험은 수요가 용량을 훨씬 초과하는 오늘날의 AI 붐이 더 이상 지속되지 않는다는 것임

NVIDIA.title: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleEn: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 후원 · HPE와 NVIDIA에 따르면 Sovereign AI는 규정 준수 문제를 극복하고 공공 부문 및 기타 규제 산업에 혁신을 제공함
NVIDIA.summary:
Pienaar and Shirhatti sit on the frontline of this shift in AI development.
The HPE Sovereign AI Factory lets customers in highly-regulated industries keep sensitive data, models, and operations under strict local control, using customized, validated infrastructure integrated with HPE services from deployment to operational support that helps customers with security, compliance, and control across infrastructure, data, and AI models.
But new mandates governing AI deployments also require them to act as careful custodians of their data, along with the infrastructure, supply chain, software and other aspects of their IT landscape.

그러나 AI 배포를 관리하는 새로운 규정에 따라 인프라, 공급망, 소프트웨어 및 기타 IT 환경 측면과 함께 데이터를 신중하게 관리해야 함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class

NVIDIA.summary:
Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.
We have moved from an era in which companies bought chips and built data centers project by project to one in which AI factories can be financed as productive infrastructure — with repeatable platforms, long-term institutional capital and a diverse customer base that uses compute to create revenue.
We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.

We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.

우리는 기업이 칩을 구입하고 프로젝트별로 데이터 센터를 구축하던 시대에서 반복 가능한 플랫폼, 장기 기관 자본 및 컴퓨팅을 사용하여 수익을 창출하는 다양한 고객 기반을 갖춘 생산적인 인프라로 AI 공장에 자금을 조달할 수 있는 시대로 전환함
우리는 Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs 및 KKR과의 파트너십을 발표하여 시간이 지남에 따라 AI 인프라 구축을 지원하기 위해 5,000억 달러 이상의 제3자 자본을 동원하도록 설계된 독립적인 금융 플랫폼을 구축함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA CEO, Glassdoor의 2026년 최고의 CEO 목록에서 1위를 차지
NVIDIA.summary:
This award recognizes CEOs “who are leading with empathy, clarity and purpose” at a time when workers are navigating increased uncertainty in the job market, according to Glassdoor, which analyzes employee ratings and reviews to identify the leaders who have earned the highest levels of employee approval and trust.
“As AI and shifting expectations redefine the modern workplace, exceptional leadership has never been more vital,” Glassdoor noted.
Glassdoor reintroduced the Best CEOs list this year after a hiatus of five years, replacing the Best-Led Companies list, which ranked NVIDIA at No. 1 in 2025, in a shift to sharpen the focus on CEO and executive leadership and its impact on employee experience and company reputation.

summaryLinesKo: 직원 평가와 리뷰를 분석하여 최고 수준의 직원 승인과 신뢰를 얻은 리더를 식별하는 Glassdoor에 따르면, 이 상은 직원들이 고용 시장의 증가하는 불확실성을 헤쳐나가고 있는 시기에 "공감, 명확성 및 목적을 가지고 리더십을 발휘하는" CEO에게 수여됨
Glassdoor는 “AI와 변화하는 기대치가 현대 직장을 재정의함에 따라 뛰어난 리더십이 그 어느 때보다 중요해졌음” · 라고 말함
Glassdoor는 2025년 NVIDIA가 1위를 차지했던 Best-Led Companies 목록을 대체하여 5년 만에 올해 Best CEOs 목록을 다시 도입함 · 이는 CEO 및 경영진 리더십과 이것이 직원 경험 및 회사 평판에 미치는 영향에 더욱 초점을 맞추는 방향으로의 전환임

NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia guarantees its own chips' value to unlock $500 billion in AI infrastructure financing
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia는 AI 인프라 금융에서 5000억 달러를 확보하기 위해 자체 칩의 가치를 보장함
NVIDIA.summary:
According to the Financial Times , which broke the deal, Nvidia's stock dropped about 1.4 percent afterward, wiping out more than $70 billion in market cap.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described the move on X as a shift from one-off projects to repeatable financing platforms.
Burry argued that GPUs become obsolete too fast for five-to-seven-year useful lives because of Nvidia's two-to-three-year upgrade cycle, and that depreciation would be understated by roughly $176 billion between 2026 and 2028 alone.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang은 X로의 전환을 일회성 프로젝트에서 반복 가능한 금융 플랫폼으로의 전환이라고 설명함

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard Deliver Faster, Smarter, More Efficient Agentic AI
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard Deliver Faster, Smarter, More Efficient Agentic AI
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 및 NeMo Switchyard는 더 빠르고, 더 스마트하고, 더 효율적인 Agentic AI를 제공함
NVIDIA.summary:
The model delivers up to 4x faster output speed, leading to 30% faster agentic task completion compared with other models in its class.
Today, NVIDIA is expanding its Nemotron 3 model family with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, the highest-efficiency model in its class for long-running agentic AI workloads.
Built for specialized tasks within larger multi-agent systems, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, helps create smarter and more efficient agentic applications.

Apple.title: Rothschild upgrades Apple to Buy as foldable iPhone and AI strategy drive optimism
Apple.titleEn: Rothschild upgrades Apple to Buy as foldable iPhone and AI strategy drive optimism
Apple.titleKo: Rothschild는 폴더블 iPhone 및 AI 전략이 낙관론을 주도함에 따라 Apple을 구매로 업그레이드함
Apple.summary:
Rothschild & Co Redburn has upgraded Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from Neutral to Buy and lifted its price target sharply to $400 from $260, citing the company's expected entry into foldable smartphones alongside the potential evolution of its artificial intelligence strategy.
A shift towards open-source models could nevertheless give Apple greater flexibility as it attempts to strengthen its position in generative AI without bearing all the costs and development risks associated with building frontier models internally.
Apple's continued dependence on third-party AI models also remains a strategic risk if the company is unable to establish a more independent approach to artificial intelligence.

The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

Apple.summary:
The legal machinery for class-action settlements grinds slowly, but a court order today in Apple’s $250 million case over its iPhone AI features potentially speeds things up by seven months.
People who bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they had the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.
In an earlier statement to CNET Managing Editor David Lumb, an Apple spokesperson said, “Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features.

Apple.title: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple이 Siri AI에 대한 도움을 위해 출판사에 눈을 돌리고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
In Engadget's early testing of Siri AI , the digital assistant was a major improvement over the version most consumers have access to right now, but it was hard not to feel like Apple still has a lot of catching up to do.
The Journal did not reveal the specific publishers Apple reached out to, but did note the company has proposed structuring payments around a variable compensation plan, which would see it pay those organizations when their content is used.
Siri AI is expected to be released with iOS 27 when it becomes available to the public sometime later this year.

Google DeepMind.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google, 이제 사용자가 AI 콘텐츠에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용 - Engadget
Google DeepMind.summary:
Visible watermarks are a great tool to help regular people quickly identify deepfakes, which in turn can help us live in a shared reality.
Google VP Josh Woodward just announced that users will be able to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images and videos.
This includes the EU, which recently announced new rules on AI transparency that mandate visible watermarks on any "authentic-looking" deepfake content.

Google DeepMind.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google은 이제 사용자가 AI 세대에서 눈에 보이는 워터마크를 제거할 수 있도록 허용함
Google DeepMind.summary:
He specified that the setting to turn the visible watermark off will be available in Gemini and Google’s video editor, Flow , with support for Search coming soon.
The change reflects an evolving approach to labeling AI-generated media, as visible watermarks can often make content less useful for professional and creative work, but the need to identify AI-generated content remains.
The feature is rolling out in the coming days, and once available, users will be able to go to Settings > Media Watermark to turn the visible mark on or off.

이러한 변화는 눈에 보이는 워터마크로 인해 콘텐츠가 전문적이고 창의적인 작업에 덜 유용할 수 있지만 AI 생성 콘텐츠를 식별해야 하는 필요성은 여전히 남아 있기 때문에 AI 생성 미디어에 레이블을 지정하는 진화하는 접근 방식을 반영함

Amazon.title: AirTag reveals how Amazon destroys rare books for AI training
Amazon.titleEn: AirTag reveals how Amazon destroys rare books for AI training
Amazon.titleKo: AirTag는 Amazon이 AI 훈련을 위해 희귀 도서를 폐기하는 방법을 밝힘
Amazon.summary:
The shipment ended up at an Amazon warehouse in Las Vegas, home to a team called VGT3 whose logo features a Tyrannosaurus rex holding a book.
Printed texts are especially valuable because they often don't exist online and predate 2022, meaning they're free of AI-generated content.
Amazon buys printed books in bulk, scans them for AI training data, and destroys them in the process.

Amazon.title: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
Amazon.titleEn: Amazon Can Use Your Twitch Content to Train Its AI—Unless You Opt Out
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon은 귀하가 옵트아웃하지 않는 한 귀하의 Twitch 콘텐츠를 사용하여 AI를 훈련할 수 있음
Amazon.summary:
However, its launch has also raised questions about how Twitch and Amazon have used that content up to now.
Twitch has updated its account settings to let streamers opt out of having their content used to help train the artificial intelligence models of Twitch’s parent company, Amazon.
In a forum dedicated to the topic, more than 16,000 creators expressed opposition to having their content being used by default to train Amazon’s AI systems—a practice that only came to light following the update to the settings.

summaryLinesKo: 그러나 출시로 인해 Twitch와 Amazon이 지금까지 해당 콘텐츠를 어떻게 사용했는지에 대한 의문도 제기됨
Twitch는 스트리머가 Twitch의 모회사인 Amazon의 인공 지능 모델을 훈련하는 데 자신의 콘텐츠를 사용하는 것을 거부할 수 있도록 계정 설정을 업데이트함
이 주제에 관한 포럼에서 16,000명 이상의 제작자가 자신의 콘텐츠가 기본적으로 Amazon의 AI 시스템을 훈련하는 데 사용되는 것에 반대를 표명함 · 이는 설정 업데이트 후에야 밝혀진 관행임

Amazon.title: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: AgentCore Observability로 온프레미스 및 멀티 클라우드 AI 에이전트 모니터링 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
In this post, we show you how to set up observability for agents running outside AWS.
Although Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, provides native tracing, monitoring, and analytics that local cloud monitoring tools don’t offer out of the box, it natively supports only agents deployed on AgentCore runtime in the AWS Cloud.
This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.

summaryLinesKo: 이 게시물에서는 AWS 외부에서 실행되는 에이전트에 대한 관찰 가능성을 설정하는 방법을 보여줌
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore의 기능인 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability는 로컬 클라우드 모니터링 도구가 기본적으로 제공하지 않는 기본 추적, 모니터링 및 분석을 제공하지만 기본적으로 AWS 클라우드의 AgentCore 런타임에 배포된 에이전트만 지원함
이를 통해 환각을 감지하고, 유해하거나 주제에서 벗어난 응답을 모니터링하고, 비용 거버넌스를 위한 토큰 사용을 추적하고, 환경 전반에 걸쳐 에이전트 동작을 감사할 수 있음

Amazon.summary:
The NYT says the plant would burn natural gas and is permitted to release 33 million tons of carbon dioxide per year — more than any other power plant in the U.S.
AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.
As part of a planned data center in Pecos County, Texas, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States, according to The New York Times .

Anthropic.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work

Anthropic.summary:
This watermarking feature, alongside C2PA support for Claude-processed images, is being introduced to meet Anthropic’s obligations under the European Union’s AI Act , which requires synthetic audio, image, video, and text to include machine-readable marks that enable the content to be detected as artificially generated or manipulated.
Anthropic says the text watermarks won’t make Claude more expensive for users, or “have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs.”
As Anthropic notes, the EU’s AI transparency requirements also impact other major AI developers, so Claude won’t be the only model introducing text watermarks.

Anthropic.title: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
Anthropic.titleKo: Anthropic은 Claude의 새로운 워터마크가 어떻게 작동하는지에 대한 자세한 내용을 공유함
Anthropic.summary:
It also noted that watermarking is distinct from the AI detection approaches offered by companies like Pangram that look for “tells” in the writing (like the construction “his isn’t [X], it’s [Y]”) to reveal AI usage: “Picking up on these patterns is fundamentally different from checking for a watermark.”
“Watermarking does not impact the quality of Claude’s output,” the company said.
More specifically, Anthropic said it will be using the SynthID-Text approach that the Google DeepMind team outlined in 2024 , and that it plans to release a watermark detection API.

Anthropic.summary:
OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.
Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

According to the Financial Times , the company, which was founded by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov, has raised $400 million at a valuation of $5.4 billion, with investors including DST Global, Goldman Sachs, Liberty Global, and Intel.
Particularly noteworthy is the shift in its customer base: While business customers accounted for less than a quarter of revenue in January, they now make up the majority.
The business model relies on sheer volume: The company maintains more than 5,000 active podcasts, and because production costs are minimal, CEO Jeanine Wright says that just 20 listeners per episode are enough to turn a profit.

OpenAI.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
OpenAI.titleEn: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
OpenAI.titleKo: ChatGPT의 컴퓨터 기록은 클릭 및 키 입력을 추적함
OpenAI.summary:
ChatGPT’s desktop app on macOS has a new feature called Computer History that turns your actions into training data, learning how you work, suggesting automations, and even picking up tasks you left half done.
In a quick demo video , Dominik Kundel, a member of the Developer Experiences team at OpenAI, shows the app looking up the last document he edited, checking if it was shared with people via Slack, and delivering a recap of how he spent his morning.
Ari Weinstein, Product and Engineering manager at OpenAI, said on X that Computer History will automatically ignore content in incognito or private browser tabs.

Ari Weinstein, Product and Engineering manager at OpenAI, said on X that Computer History will automatically ignore content in incognito or private browser tabs.

빠른 데모 영상에서 OpenAI의 개발자 경험팀 멤버인 Dominik Kundel은 자신이 마지막으로 편집한 문서를 검색하고 해당 문서가 Slack을 통해 사람들과 공유되었는지 확인하고 자신이 아침을 어떻게 보냈는지 요약하는 앱을 보여줌

Instructing the model on when to invoke subagents can increase the likelihood of spawning agents only in situations where the additional token expenditures would result in better performance.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI와 Anthropic은 중국 AI 경쟁업체의 입지를 확보하면서 가격 전쟁을 벌이고 있음
OpenAI.summary:
OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.
Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

SpaceX, which merged with Elon Musk's AI company xAI earlier this year, paid $60 billion for the purchase.
In its announcement , Cursor said that it will now have access to "the largest fleet of GPUs in the world," which will give it the computing capacity to build and train better models that it can offer its customers at a lower cost.
The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
As a whole, SpaceX increased revenue by 92 percent year-over-year, bringing its total revenue for the quarter to $7.8 billion.
Further complicating those numbers is that Anthropic has agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center for its compute needs.
The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.

Perplexity.title: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
Perplexity.titleEn: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
Perplexity.titleKo: Perplexity는 AI 쇼핑 봇에 대한 Amazon의 금지 명령을 성공적으로 번복함
Perplexity.summary:
According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.
Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.
According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesEn: According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.

Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.

According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.
summaryLinesKo: 제9순회항소법원의 의견에 따르면, Perplexity가 컴퓨터 사기 및 남용법(CFAA)을 위반했다는 Amazon의 원래 주장은 조사를 통과하지 못했으며 금지 명령으로 보상받아서는 안 됨
Perplexity가 법을 위반했다고 성공적으로 주장하려면 Amazon은 회사가 허가 없이 의도적으로 컴퓨터에 액세스하고 보호된 컴퓨터에서 정보를 얻었으며 "1년 동안 한 명 이상의 사람에게" 평균 가치가 5,000달러 이상인 손실이 있었다는 사실을 증명해야 함
Amazon에 따르면 두 회사는 2024년에 에이전트 쇼핑을 조기에 중단하는 데 동의했지만 Perplexity는 합의를 취소하고 Comet의 AI 봇을 일반 Chrome 브라우저로 위장하여 기능을 다시 활성화함

Mistral AI.title: Mistral AI wants to build 1 gigawatt of European compute by 2030 — and lock in customers now.
Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral AI wants to build 1 gigawatt of European compute by 2030 — and lock in customers now.
Mistral AI.titleKo: Mistral AI는 2030년까지 1기가와트의 유럽 컴퓨팅을 구축하고 지금 고객을 확보하고자 함
Mistral AI.summary:
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard enables intelligent model routing, allowing Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to be deployed alongside other models for optimal task allocation, and the open release includes permissive licensing, weights, data, and recipes for extensive customization and broad ecosystem support.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30B parameter, open Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 3B active parameters, specifically optimized for high-volume, low-latency execution in always-on AI agents and agentic workflows.
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning combines strong intelligence with up to 4x output speed of similar-sized models, placing it on the accuracy-speed Pareto frontier for high-volume agent workloads.

summaryLinesKo: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 강력한 인텔리전스와 유사한 크기의 모델의 최대 4배 빠른 출력 속도를 결합하여 대용량 에이전트 워크로드를 위한 정확도 속도 Pareto 최전선에 배치함
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard는 지능형 모델 라우팅을 지원하여 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning을 다른 모델과 함께 배치하여 최적의 작업 할당을 수행할 수 있도록 하며, 공개 릴리스에는 광범위한 사용자 정의 및 폭넓은 생태계 지원을 위한 허용 라이센스, 가중치, 데이터 및 레시피가 포함되어 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning은 30B 매개변수, 3B 활성 매개변수를 갖춘 개방형 MoE(Mixture-of-Experts) 모델로, 특히 상시 가동되는 AI 에이전트 및 에이전트 워크플로우에서 대용량, 짧은 지연 시간 실행에 최적화되어 있음

Mistral AI.title: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
Mistral AI.summary:
Last September, Mistral raised almost $2 billion at a $13.5 billion valuation; it's reportedly teeing up another raise that will bump that figure to $23 billion.
Unlike the leading American labs, locked in a race to superintelligence , Mistral has shifted its focus toward smaller, bespoke models for manufacturing, utilities, and financial services.
“Everybody outside the US and China should participate in the open source ecosystem, because it takes leverage away,” says Nicolas Granatino, founder of startup accelerator StemAI, who holds a stake in Mistral in a personal capacity.

Sierra AI.titleEn: Defense in depth in the age of agents
Sierra AI.summary:
Supervisors catch nuance that fixed rules can’t, but as agents themselves they share some of the limitations they’re built to detect.
Other threats involve bad content that should never appear in a conversation, regardless of who introduced it.
The basic idea of defense in depth — that you need layers — is the same, but agents change what those layers do.

Sierra AI.title: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
Sierra AI.titleEn: Teaching agents to navigate janky IVR systems
Sierra AI.titleKo: 버벅거리는 IVR 시스템을 탐색하는 방법을 상담원에게 교육
Sierra AI.summary:
Agents built on Sierra can now navigate the most challenging IVR systems out of the box: they understand when to call, how to get through a multi-level menu, when to stay silent, and how to recognize when they’ve reached a person.
Or an auto insurance company needs to call a repair shop to get the status and estimated cost of a customer’s repair.
With IVR navigation skills out of the box, an agent’s success rates increase by almost 50% to 85% — and this capability is already being used by a number of our customers.

Resolution rates increased from 50% to over 70%, indicating that more than two-thirds of member questions are now resolved instantly.

Sierra AI.summary:
Ease of use: We wanted users spending their time on high-leverage decisions — not on figuring out how to be productive in a different system with different limitations.
Before Pinecone, it wasn't unusual to see engineers walking around the office with half-open laptops — not because they were working, but because their AI agents were.
The stateful runner layer is where the agentic environment lives and is composed of all the on-demand pods created by the control plane.

Replit.title: Replit CEO's surprising take: AI is making software engineering more human
Replit.titleEn: Replit CEO's surprising take: AI is making software engineering more human

Replit.summary:
Masad said that Replit, an integrated coding environment he cofounded in 2016, reached an inflection point in 2025 when Anthropic began releasing its Opus models.
Masad said Replit adapted by shifting its mission from teaching people how to code to making coding as easy as possible.
Software engineers themselves have said that coding with AI, while more efficient, quickly leads to burnout, and at least a dozen major companies have laid off workers, citing AI as a reason.

Replit.title: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself
Replit.titleEn: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself
Replit.titleKo: 스스로 운영할 수 있는 회사를 만드는 리플릿 CEO
Replit.summary:
In March, Replit raised $400 million at a $9 billion valuation — triple what it was worth six months earlier.
Last month the company launched Replit Design , an agent-based creative tool.
It was actually kind of a painful moment, because here you are, you dedicated your life — I've been working on making coding easier for literally 15 years, most of my adult life — and I'm saying everything that I worked toward is kind of moot, and the way forward is that we make programming so easy that anyone could do it.

Cohere.summary:
Cohere Health implemented this using AgentCore Gateway with separate targets for shared tools and project-specific tools.
America’s Health Insurance Plans (AHIP) – The AHIP commitments require health plans to achieve 80 percent real-time approvals for electronic prior authorization submissions.

Not one model published in 2026 reaches the download top 25, while thirteen of the twenty-five date from 2022. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 was pulled 1.55 billion times in seven months against 5,156 likes; Kimi-K3 was pulled about 60 times per like it received.
Going forward, however, the industry is likely to shift toward clearer monetization paths from open-source adoption.
Meanwhile, Chinese open models are increasingly optimized for domestic chips, the same competition in reverse, where models are designed around specific hardware ecosystems.

Hugging Face.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
Hugging Face.titleEn: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
Hugging Face.titleKo: ICML의 2,200개 논문을 재현하여 우리가 배운 것
Hugging Face.summary:
In total, 3,978 individual claims were confirmed with real experiments. 23% of examined papers (496) had at least one claim falsified or contested.
Participants received $20 in Hugging Face compute credits to run experiments on HF Jobs ; across the challenge, participants launched 2,962 cloud jobs.
ICML 2026 received 23,918 submissions and accepted 6,352 papers , roughly double the previous year, continuing an exponential trend that is at least partly driven by AI agents making it faster to run experiments and write them up.

참가자들은 HF Jobs에 대한 실험을 실행하기 위해 Hugging Face 컴퓨팅 크레딧으로 20달러를 받았음 · 챌린지 전반에 걸쳐 참가자들은 2,962개의 클라우드 일자리를 시작함

Hugging Face.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
Hugging Face.titleEn: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
Hugging Face.titleKo: Strands Agents, LeRobot 및 Hugging Face Storage Buckets를 사용하여 한 곳에서 기록, 훈련 및 배포
Hugging Face.summary:
To record on a physical SO-101, LeRobot's record CLI handles the leader-follower bring-up: The dataset lands on disk in the same format as the simulation recording, so the same sync call takes it to a bucket: sync_dataset_to_bucket("./recordings", "my-org/robot-fave", run_id="run-021") (or the hf sync ./recordings hf://buckets/my-org/robot-fave/run-021 CLI it wraps).
The first post in this series introduced Strands Robots , an open source SDK from AWS ( Apache 2.0 ) that exposes robot abstractions, simulation, and the LeRobot stack as AgentTools you compose into a single Strands agent.
Each of those decisions comes up dozens of times over a collection campaign, and each one needs a look at what came back before the next command goes out.

이 시리즈의 첫 번째 게시물에서는 단일 Strands 에이전트로 구성하는 AgentTools로 로봇 추상화, 시뮬레이션 및 LeRobot 스택을 노출하는 AWS(Apache 2.0)의 오픈 소스 SDK인 Strands Robots를 소개함

Hugging Face.title: Thinking of ACE? We Can Do It with Fewer Tokens
Hugging Face.titleEn: Thinking of ACE? We Can Do It with Fewer Tokens
Hugging Face.titleKo: 에이스를 생각하시나요 · 더 적은 토큰으로 할 수 있음
Hugging Face.summary:
On DeepSeek-V3.2 the story flips: the stronger model absorbs ACE's full playbook well enough to edge us on Medium, but we lead Easy, Hard, and Overall — with more capacity to spare, more lessons (delivered our way) keep helping instead of crowding each other out.
Two recent systems do exactly this, on the same kind of agent: ACE (Agentic Context Engineering) and our ALTK-Evolve ( introduced here ).
Every distinct guideline keeps a support count — how many independent episodes produced it — and we never summarize the store down to a handful of rules.

Hugging Face.title: Build Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents: Open Weights & Full Deployment Control with NVIDIA Magpie TTS
Hugging Face.titleEn: Build Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents: Open Weights & Full Deployment Control with NVIDIA Magpie TTS
Hugging Face.titleKo: 지연 시간이 짧은 다국어 음성 에이전트 구축 · NVIDIA Magpie TTS를 통한 개방형 가중치 및 전체 배포 제어
Hugging Face.summary:
The newly added Arabic (1.62% CER), Korean (2.69%), and Brazilian Portuguese (2.91%) models establish baseline quality for future improvements.
At 32ms on B200, Magpie's TTFA leaves the rest of the latency budget for ASR and LLM processing — keeping total end-to-end latency within the sub-200ms window natural conversation requires.
With open weights, production-ready NVIDIA NIM , and support for 12 languages, you can deploy multilingual speech inside your own infrastructure, optimize latency for your workload, and customize the model for your domain — end to end, in your own environment.
summaryLinesEn: The newly added Arabic (1.62% CER), Korean (2.69%), and Brazilian Portuguese (2.91%) models establish baseline quality for future improvements.
At 32ms on B200, Magpie's TTFA leaves the rest of the latency budget for ASR and LLM processing — keeping total end-to-end latency within the sub-200ms window natural conversation requires.

With open weights, production-ready NVIDIA NIM , and support for 12 languages, you can deploy multilingual speech inside your own infrastructure, optimize latency for your workload, and customize the model for your domain — end to end, in your own environment.
summaryLinesKo: 새로 추가된 아랍어(1.62% CER), 한국어(2.69%) 및 브라질 포르투갈어(2.91%) 모델은 향후 개선을 위한 기준 품질을 설정함
B200의 32ms에서 Magpie의 TTFA는 ASR 및 LLM 처리를 위한 나머지 대기 시간 예산을 남겨두고 자연스러운 대화에 필요한 200ms 미만 창 내에서 총 엔드투엔드 대기 시간을 유지함

Writer.title: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleEn: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleKo: AI가 듣고 있는 곳에 표시하는 방법 · 구매자 대화를 통해 AI 가시성 구축
Writer.summary:
You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.
It means deciding which questions matter most, building PR and communications around those questions, showing up in the social and review platforms AI reads, and making sure your story is consistent across every surface where AI forms an opinion about your brand.
Marketbridge analyzed more than 17,000 AI citations across multiple industries and reached the same conclusion: “Organizations that treat GEO as a technical add-on risk missing the bigger picture.”
summaryLinesEn: You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.

It means deciding which questions matter most, building PR and communications around those questions, showing up in the social and review platforms AI reads, and making sure your story is consistent across every surface where AI forms an opinion about your brand.
Marketbridge analyzed more than 17,000 AI citations across multiple industries and reached the same conclusion: “Organizations that treat GEO as a technical add-on risk missing the bigger picture.”
summaryLinesKo: 귀하는 구매자가 기대하는 속도와 시장이 인식하는 목소리로 구매자가 사용하는 정확한 언어로 콘텐츠를 구축하고 있음
이는 어떤 질문이 가장 중요한지 결정하고, 해당 질문을 중심으로 PR 및 커뮤니케이션을 구축하고, AI가 읽는 소셜 및 리뷰 플랫폼에 표시하고, AI가 브랜드에 대한 의견을 형성하는 모든 표면에서 스토리가 일관되도록 하는 것을 의미함
Marketbridge는 여러 업계에 걸쳐 17,000개 이상의 AI 인용을 분석한 결과 다음과 같은 동일한 결론에 도달함 · "GEO를 기술적 추가 기능으로 취급하는 조직은 더 큰 그림을 놓칠 위험이 있음"

Writer.titleEn: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
Writer.titleKo: WRITER, Palmyra X6 출시 및 주요 하네스 업그레이드를 통해 Agentic AI를 엔터프라이즈 규모에서 경제적으로 지속 가능하게 만듬
Writer.summary:
Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.
New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.
X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).

Writer.titleKo: WRITER의 새로운 기능 · 예산을 초과하지 않고 확장되는 에이전트 작업
Writer.summary:
At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.
The shift is from piloting agents to running them in production, across thousands of employees, with spend governed and aligned to ROI instead of left uncapped.
It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

sourceLines: At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.

It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

Meanwhile, the DeepSeek V4 Flash model will set you back $1.32 for 1 million output tokens (from $0.28) during peak hours and $0.66 during off-peak.

DeepSeek.titleKo: 새로운 Deepseek Flash 모델은 OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Luna와 약 60% 더 저렴한 비용으로 일치함
DeepSeek.summary:
That puts it just one point behind OpenAI's budget model GPT-5.6 Luna, but it costs about 60 percent less per task, even after OpenAI's 80 percent price cut .
According to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , the new version scores 50 points, ten more than the previous V4 Flash that launched in April 2026.
A big reason for the gap is Deepseek's 98 percent cache discount , well above the industry-standard 90 percent.

Apps Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store Sarah Perez AI Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs Anna Heim Climate Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct Tim De Chant
On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan take a look at Glimmer, Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word manifesto, and more of the week’s headlines, from the true cost of the AI industry’s energy needs to a $250M acquisition gone very wrong.
The release landed alongside a letter from Mark Zuckerberg arguing AI should be “for everyone” rather than controlled by a handful of labs, but as Equity’s hosts point out, the vision comes with some asterisks .

Meta AI.title: Mark Zuckerberg's AI manifesto is exactly why people don't like AI

Meta AI.titleKo: Mark Zuckerberg의 AI 선언문은 사람들이 AI를 좋아하지 않는 이유임
Meta AI.summary:
So it’s worth pinning down exactly what’s happening here, and why Zuckerberg isn’t doing the industry any favors with essays like this.
I don’t bring this up to imply that Zuckerberg should withdraw to the wilderness in shame — but the fallout from social media is one of the central reasons we’re now seeing so much anxiety about the social impact of AI.
On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the “personal superintelligence” systems Meta AI is building.

Meta AI.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta의 새로운 Glimmer AI 모델은 Zuckerberg의 개인 지능 비전에 대한 힌트를 제공함
Meta AI.summary:
Zuckerberg went on to list the ways Meta’s superintelligence can improve a person’s life, from providing a capable personal agent that “will work 24/7 on your behalf to improve your relationships, health, career, finances, home management, hobbies, and more” to giving people access to tools needed to create a new business or advance scientific progress.
Meta imagines Glimmer being used for things like managing schedules, drafting messages, and organizing files — tasks that would require large amounts of access to personal data.
Meta on Monday released Muse Glimmer , an open-weight model designed to power AI agents locally on consumer hardware, providing the clearest picture yet of what CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s vision of “personal superintelligence” could look like in practice.

summaryLinesKo: Zuckerberg는 계속해서 Meta의 초지능이 개인의 삶을 향상시킬 수 있는 방법을 나열함 · "당신을 대신하여 연중무휴 24시간 일하여 관계, 건강, 경력, 재정, 가정 관리, 취미 등을 개선하는" 능력 있는 개인 에이전트를 제공하는 것부터 사람들에게 새로운 비즈니스를 창출하거나 과학적 진보를 진전시키는 데 필요한 도구에 대한 액세스를 제공하는 것까지 포함됨
Meta는 Glimmer가 일정 관리, 메시지 초안 작성, 파일 정리와 같은 작업(개인 데이터에 대한 대량 액세스가 필요한 작업)에 사용될 것이라고 상상함
Meta는 월요일 소비자 하드웨어에서 로컬로 AI 에이전트를 구동하도록 설계된 개방형 모델인 Muse Glimmer를 출시하여 CEO Mark Zuckerberg의 "개인 초지능" 비전이 실제로 어떤 모습일 수 있는지에 대한 가장 명확한 그림을 제공함

sourceLines: Zuckerberg went on to list the ways Meta’s superintelligence can improve a person’s life, from providing a capable personal agent that “will work 24/7 on your behalf to improve your relationships, health, career, finances, home management, hobbies, and more” to giving people access to tools needed to create a new business or advance scientific progress.
Meta imagines Glimmer being used for things like managing schedules, drafting messages, and organizing files — tasks that would require large amounts of access to personal data.
